title: Enterprise AI Vendor & Procurement Assessment
description: Multi-disciplinary evaluation workflow for procuring third-party AI models and SaaS integrations.

steps.title: AI System Use-Case Classification
steps.objective: Classify model risk level, data inputs, and degree of human oversight.
steps.prompt_guidance: Classify enterprise AI risk level and identify prohibited capabilities.
steps.verification_gate: Confirm whether system involves autonomous biometric scanning or employment triage.

steps.title: Data Privacy & Training Data Audit
steps.objective: Audit whether customer data will be ingested for foundational model retraining.
steps.prompt_guidance: Verify zero-data-retention policy and opt-out of model training.
steps.verification_gate: Mandate explicit contractual prohibition against training public models on customer inputs.

steps.title: Comprehensive AI Impact Assessment
steps.objective: Assess hallucination guardrails, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and fallback mechanisms.
steps.prompt_guidance: Draft full AI Impact Assessment establishing PEAS operational parameters.
steps.verification_gate: Ensure deterministic fallback exists for mission-critical automated processes.
